Synopsis:
    A fire destroyed two schools and approximately 300 wooden houses in Bukavu, a city under control of the Rwanda-backed AFC/M23 rebel movement in eastern DRC. At least 24 children were killed (19 girls, 5 boys), 29 injured, with the final death toll potentially higher. Cause under investigation.
